## About
Willow Automotive Service, Inc. sits on South Wabash in the South Loop. Our Service Center specializes in Mercedes-Benz, Porsche and BMW, and we have decades of experience with exotic and special interest vehicles.
The work runs from routine maintenance to performance upgrades and major overhauls. To insure reliability and overall quality, we only use OEM parts.
Our Sales and Service departments work as one team. Most of the pre-owned vehicles we offer come from existing customers, so we know their condition and service history well.

## Services
- Routine scheduled maintenance: Ongoing care for your Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, BMW or other specialty vehicle, from an oil change to a major service.
- ECU Reprogramming / Computer Filing: Non-invasive computer tuning to draw more performance from your engine.
- Forced Induction Systems (Turbos & Superchargers): Aftermarket systems installed, or a system designed specifically for your vehicle, done right to keep the engine reliable and durable.
- Custom Exhaust Systems: A tuned exhaust fabricated for your vehicle, for more performance or a more aggressive sound.
- High Performance Brake Systems: Brake set-ups that improve stopping power, on the street or at the track.
- Sport Suspension Modifications: Suspension work to sharpen handling and improve lap times.
- Managing and maintaining collections: A single point of contact for an entire collection, with scheduled rotation for preventive maintenance and help sourcing rare parts.
- Sales & Consignment: A selection of pre-owned specialty vehicles, whether you want a daily driver or the crown jewel of a collection.

## FAQ
Q: Which cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Mercedes-Benz, Porsche and BMW, and we work on every other type of luxury, exotic and special interest vehicle, including Ferrari.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call us at 312.881.0101. You can also reach us by email at info@willowauto.com.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can you store my car?
A: Yes. We offer indoor vehicle storage with battery maintenance, as well as winter and summer tire storage.

Q: Where do the cars you sell come from?
A: Most come from existing customers, so we are very familiar with each car's condition and service history.
